column7: IsLinkLocal (the narrower SSRF-target check used by the JWKS/OIDC egress guard and now internal/connect's hardened transport) did not decode NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96) or IPv4-compatible (::x) IPv6 encodings of an embedded link-local IPv4 -- only IsPrivateOrLinkLocal had that decode step (#1937/ssrf-nat64-ipv4compat-001); a NAT64-encoded cloud IMDS target would pass IsLinkLocal despite IsPrivateOrLinkLocal already rejecting it. Fixed by refactoring both predicates onto one shared matchesCIDRsWithEmbedded helper; found while implementing the Connect hardened-client link-local guard, which needed IsLinkLocal to have the same coverage IsPrivateOrLinkLocal already did
